verdict.rationale: MotherDuck Flights run scheduled Python jobs inside the platform for ingest, enrichment and transformation, with managed scheduling, runtime, secrets, logging and versioning. That covers scheduled, task-style transformations. The pack shows no streams, change tracking, continuous queries or native declarative pipelines, and dbt runs as an external tool through an adapter rather than in-platform. missing for 10: native streams/CDC or continuous queries, incremental/declarative pipeline primitives, independent or hands-on corroboration of Flights.
